content.classification: Internal operational data; shipment contacts may contain personal information.

requirements.text: Canadian personal information must remain stored and processed in Canada.
All interactive users must use SAML SSO and MFA; local user authentication is prohibited, including break-glass accounts.
Production access logs must be exported to SentinelForge within five minutes.
Non-production environments may not contain unmasked shipment-contact data.

content.securityReviewStatus: Conditional approval pending architecture evidence for SEC-01 and SEC-03.
